row.body: The lock-up key is packed with a field bag; the rental card says the unit was opened before the listed test equipment was delivered.
row.title: Storage unit opened early

sidecar.gloss: A storage unit opens before its equipment delivery.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency cache could be opened ahead of a delayed delivery; the card does not say what the unit contained.

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
